hyperparameters_summary: loss=squared_error, max_iter=600, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=50, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=True, validation_fraction=0.1, random_state=42; calendar/holiday features and 168-hour/364-day load lags.
anomalies: System Python lacked required packages. Three uv installation attempts reported lowercase 'error:' and 'Operation not permitted' despite is_error=false; these are excluded from the literal case-sensitive command_failures count.
Created and repeatedly recreated a local .venv, eventually installing packages through pip instead of using the provided ancestor venv.
Forecast execution exceeded the 120-second command timeout, moved to the background, and subsequently completed successfully.
GBM was announced before scoring; test_selected reflects the literal three-forecast test comparison and presentation of its winner, with no observed tuning after test scoring.
Dropping unavailable annual lags made the effective training interval 2015-12-31 through 2019-12-31, narrower than the final message's broad 2015–2019 description.
Daily summaries use Berlin dates, producing a one-hour January 8 bucket; the CSV correctly contains all 168 requested UTC hours.
Plot code labels local time but uses DateFormatter without an explicit timezone.
CSV MAPE recomputes to 2.7988854946098%, consistent with the reported 2.80%.
one_line_summary: Produced a 168-hour gradient-boosted load forecast with 2.80% MAPE, compared against two test-week baselines, using pre-2020 training data and known lags; delivered CSV and plot after environment-installation retries.
